create_ENorm_for_linear_model: create an ENorm instance with model named parameters and SGD optimizer for a linear network
create_ENorm_for_conv_model: create an ENorm instance with model named parameters and SGD optimizer for a convolutional network
run_ENorm_step: run the ENorm step method to apply equi-normalization balancing across all weight layers
review_ENorm_step_fc: review the ENorm _step_fc method that balances weights in fully-connected networks using p-norms
review_ENorm_step_conv: review the ENorm _step_conv method that balances convolutional weights and updates SGD momentum buffers
